sources.entry: Drupal Commerce - Popular e-commerce module for Drupal CMS, with support for dozens of payment, shipping, and shopping related modules. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.name: Drupal Commerce
summary.one_liner: An open-source e-commerce platform and module set built on the Drupal CMS for selling any type of product online.
use_cases: Building an online store on Drupal
Selling physical or digital products online
Adding faceted product search and filtering
Creating promotions and coupons for a shop
Integrating an online store with ERP or custom systems
summary.what_it_does: Drupal Commerce is an e-commerce framework that runs on the Drupal CMS, combining product, content, and order management in one platform. Commerce Core provides a product data model with media library, layout building, and content management for product pages. It integrates Drupal's Search API for keyword search, category browsing, and facet filtering, and can optionally pull product listings from external engines such as Solr or Elastic. Its free module library offers 100+ integrations for payments, shipping, and other shop features, and its APIs and event system allow custom integrations and automation. Centarro maintains the platform and offers consultation.
notable: Runs on Drupal CMS, combining content, product, and order management
100+ integrations in a free module library
Native Drupal Search API integration with optional Solr or Elastic product listings
Multi-site, multi-language, multi-currency, and multi-checkout-flow support
caveats: Consulting and build help come from Centarro, which is a paid service and not described in pricing terms on the page
Requires a Drupal-based site, so it is tied to the Drupal ecosystem
